description.value: Be love is a plant-based vegetarian restaurant in downtown Victoria with a seasonal menu sourced from local farms and the surrounding wilds. Everything on the menu is wheat, gluten, dairy, and processed sugar free, making it a rare all-inclusive stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions. The restaurant emphasizes health, sustainability, and scratch cooking, and offers both dine-in with reservations and takeout including DoorDash delivery.
